speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me, where exactly is your abdominal pain located and on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is it? Also, when did this sudden onset begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis. Given the patient's age, recent acute myocardial infarction, and classic presentation of sudden periumbilical pain followed by bloody diarrhea, I am requesting a colonoscopy and fecal calprotectin to confirm ischemic injury and rule out infectious colitis or diverticulitis. REQUEST TEST: Colonoscopy; REQUEST TEST: Fecal_Calprotectin; REQUEST IMAGES: Colonoscopy
